scope.binding: one exact product/account/region/credential rail; no endpoint or identity fallback
scope.identityVersion: existing independent Kiro IDE/CLI and Amazon Q CLI contracts
scope.terminal: existing strict EventStream CRC, unique terminal and EOF

localPolicy.unit: ASCII base64 characters in the final wire field, including padding
localPolicy.limitAuthority: local conservative budget, not a proven official vendor limit
localPolicy.waitQueue: none; admission rejection is a local capacity error
localPolicy.cancel: cooperative checkpoints; permit and memory stay with the worker until actual completion
localPolicy.gif: preserve original animation and bytes when within field budget; reject oversize without flattening
localPolicy.orientation: apply embedded EXIF orientation before static image re-encoding
localPolicy.oversizeAfterConvergence: explicit local rejection; never emit an oversized field
localPolicy.decodeFailure: reject; never passthrough a failed static conversion

cases: compressed bytes below 400000 but base64 above 400000
high entropy PNG/JPEG within and beyond the static dimension cap
EXIF rotation and extreme aspect ratio
valid animated GIF roundtrip and oversized GIF rejection
twenty unique images and total pixel/encoding work rejection
bounded blocking admission, cancellation and memory ownership
both independent products across Claude Messages, Chat and Responses
